name: Sikaplan WP Protection Sheet-15 HE
paste:
SIKAPLAN® WP PROTECTION SHEET-15 HE: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sikaplan® WP Protection Sheet-15 HE, April 2023, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/s/sikaplan-wp-protectionsheet-15he.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sikaplan® WP Protection Sheet-15 HE where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description. Sikaplan® WP Protection Sheet-15 HE is a homogeneous protective membrane with an embossed surface, based on polyvinylchloride (PVC-p).
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Protection of waterproofing membranes on base of PVC-p, also in combination with injection backup systems.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.4.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sikaplan® WP Protection Sheet-15 HE
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Protection sheet for waterproofing membranes
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates. Quality Management System EN ISO 9001/ ISO 14001
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN ISO 9001: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - ISO 14001: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - EN 1849-2: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Product Information > Effective thickness (p.2).
    - EN 12691: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Resistance to impact (p.2).
    - EN ISO 12236: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Resistance to static puncture (p.2).
    - EN 14416: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Resistance to root penetration (p.2).
    - ISO 527: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Elongation (p.2); Technical Information > Tensile strength (p.2).
    - EN 13501-1: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Technical Information > Reaction to fire (p.2).
    - EN ISO 11925-2: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Technical Information > Reaction to fire (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Embossed surface to allow proper spreading of repair injection material
    - High resistance to mechanical influences
    - Without DEHP (DOP) plasticisers
    - High dimensional stability under permanent pressure and heat
    - Flexible at cold temperatures
    - Suitable for contact with acidic soft water and alkaline environments
    - Resistant to root penetration and micro-organisms
    - Optimized workability, thermally weldable
    - Can be installed on damp and even wet substrates
    - Temporary UV stability for installation
2.5 Appearance and colour. top: 0.4 mm embossing; Surface; reverse: smooth
    | Colour | shades of grey |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Mass per area: ~2.0 kg/m²
    - Resistance to impact: Watertight at 500 mm drop height; (500 g falling weight, Method A) (EN 12691)
    - Resistance to static puncture: ≥ 1.0 kN (EN ISO 12236)
    - Resistance to root penetration: Pass (EN 14416)
    - Tensile strength: ≥ 10 N/mm² (machine/ cross direction) (ISO 527)
    - Elongation: ≥ 200 % (machine/ cross direction) (ISO 527)
    - Service temperature: - 10 °C min./+ 35 °C max.
    - Ambient maximum temperature of liquids: + 35 °C
2.7 Reaction to fire.
    | Class E | (EN 13501-1)(EN ISO 11925-2) |
2.8 System structure. Ancillary Products:
    - All Sikaplan® WP (PVC based) membranes
2.9 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Shelf life: 5 years shelf life from date of production if stored properly in undamaged, unopened, original sealed packaging
2.10 Packaging.
    | Roll size | 2.20 m (width) x roll length indi- |
    | vidual and as specified |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
2.11 Storage conditions. Rolls must be stored in their original packaging, in a horizontal position and in cool and dry conditions. They must be protected from direct sunlight, rain, snow and ice, etc. Do not stack pallets of rolls during transport or storage.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality. Substrate conditions are as defined for the waterproofing membrane system which is to be protected with the Sikaplan® WP Protection Sheet-15 HE.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Effective thickness: 1.6 (-5 % / +10 %) mm incl. embossing (EN 1849-2)
4.3 Application method / tools. The protective membrane must be fastened by welding to any compatible PVC waterproofing membrane in accordance with the Sika Method Statement for sheet waterproofing membrane installations (available separately on request). The jointing faces must be dry and free from any contaminations.
4.4 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Installation works must only be carried out by Sika® trained contractors.
    - The membrane is not UV stabilized and cannot be installed on structures permanently exposed to sunlight and weathering.
    - The membrane is not resistant to permanent contact with bitumen, and some types of plastics other than PVC or Sika approved system components.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. +5 °C min.
5.3 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Effective thickness: 1.6 (-5 % / +10 %) mm incl. embossing (EN 1849-2)
    - Resistance to impact: Watertight at 500 mm drop height; (500 g falling weight, Method A) (EN 12691)
    - Resistance to static puncture: ≥ 1.0 kN (EN ISO 12236)
    - Resistance to root penetration: Pass (EN 14416)
    - Tensile strength: ≥ 10 N/mm² (machine/ cross direction) (ISO 527)
    - Elongation: ≥ 200 % (machine/ cross direction) (ISO 527)
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sikaplan® WP Protection Sheet-15 HE, April 2023, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/s/sikaplan-wp-protectionsheet-15he.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety - Regulation (ec) no 1907/2006 - reach. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
